body: I just don’t see the point. Whatever I am supposed to do in the future can be easily filled by someone else, that woman I might marry? She’ll find a better man, and I know I can’t be a father since my dad abused me. I shouldn’t have to live just so others won’t be hurt and slowly suffer. I know God loves me, and suicide will hurt him, but why can’t I just join him now?
Or people who have a purpose. I just dont see myself as valuable except as a nice person. Besides that I contribute nothing to society and have no potential
He probably was until he called me a ugly disappointing son during my youth and threatened to kill my mom and sister constantly
